question: ((0.5)⁴ - (0.4)⁴)/((0.5)² + (0.4)²) = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The expression is in the form (a⁴ − b⁴) ÷ (a² + b²).

Using (a²)² − (b²)² = (a² − b²)(a² + b²), the expression reduces to a² − b².

Substituting a = 0.5 and b = 0.4:

(0.5)² − (0.4)² = 0.25 − 0.16 = 0.09.</
